notes: The 16-sentinel Article 1 GF-02 suite is reconciled to canonical intellectual-document identities from the operational sentinel map and staging audit. Identity resolution is not retrieval evidence: it does not imply provider recall, PILOT success, PRESS approval, freeze, FORMAL execution, inclusion, or PRISMA eligibility. Institutional-parent identities without a single bibliographic parent identifier remain allow_title_match=false so they cannot silently inflate bibliographic recall.

sentinels.canonical_title: Lifestyle Interventions for Treatment and Remission of Type 2 Diabetes and Prediabetes in Adults: A Clinical Practice Guideline From the American College of Lifestyle Medicine
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the principal ACLM clinical practice guideline as one intellectual document; executive summaries and clinician materials are linked derivatives and do not increase the denominator.
sentinels.relationship_notes: Canonical sentinel is the principal adult T2D/prediabetes guideline. Linked summary/implementation materials may support provenance but do not substitute for the parent identity.

sentinels.canonical_title: 2025 Brazilian evidence-based guideline on the management of obesity and prevention of cardiovascular disease and obesity-associated complications: a position statement by five medical societies.
sentinels.issuer: ABESO; Brazilian Diabetes Society; Brazilian Society of Endocrinology and Metabolism; Brazilian Society of Cardiology; Brazilian Society of Bariatric and Metabolic Surgery
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the Brazilian five-society evidence-based obesity/CVD position statement as one intellectual document; journal co-publications are manifestations of the same family.
sentinels.relationship_notes: The canonical map anchors the family to PMCID PMC12625227. Parallel society/journal manifestations must be reconciled rather than double-counted.

sentinels.canonical_title: Health Effects of Sugar-Sweetened and Artificially Sweetened Beverages: Umbrella Review and Evidence-Based Consensus Statement of the Korean Diabetes Association and the Korean Nutrition Society.
sentinels.issuer: Korean Diabetes Association; Korean Nutrition Society
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the joint Korean evidence-based consensus statement as one principal document; population mix does not create separate sentinel units.
sentinels.relationship_notes: Adult applicability is an eligibility question separate from known-item identity and recall QA.

sentinels.canonical_title: Remission of Type 2 Diabetes: Diabetes Canada Clinical Practice Guidelines Expert Working Group
sentinels.issuer: Diabetes Canada Clinical Practice Guidelines Expert Working Group
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the principal Diabetes Canada remission chapter as the sentinel unit; the User's Guide and introductory editorial are linked materials.
sentinels.relationship_notes: The principal guideline is PMID 36567079 / DOI 10.1016/j.jcjd.2022.10.004. DOI 10.1016/j.jcjd.2022.10.009 is the introductory editorial and DOI 10.1016/j.jcjd.2022.10.005 is the linked User's Guide.

sentinels.canonical_title: Obesity Canada Adult clinical practice guideline
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the living Adult Clinical Practice Guideline family as the parent intellectual unit; chapters are versioned analytic components, with Medical Nutrition Therapy updated in 2022.
sentinels.relationship_notes: The family launched in 2020 and is maintained as a living multichapter guideline. Chapter updates do not create a new parent sentinel unless a chapter is an autonomous normative product.

sentinels.canonical_title: American Association of Clinical Endocrinology Consensus Statement: Algorithm for the Evaluation and Treatment of Adults with Obesity/Adiposity-Based Chronic Disease - 2025 Update.
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the 2025 AACE obesity/ABCD consensus algorithm update as one principal normative document.
sentinels.relationship_notes: Institutional AACE Clinical Guidance is the primary expected route; bibliographic manifestations may also recover the same unit.

sentinels.canonical_title: Nutritional and lifestyle supportive care recommendations for management of obesity with GLP-1-based therapies: An expert consensus statement using a modified Delphi approach.
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the expert consensus as one intellectual document; preserve the 2025 electronic-publication / 2026 collection-volume date distinction without duplicating the record.
sentinels.relationship_notes: Electronic publication and issue/collection year differ; they represent the same document.

sentinels.canonical_title: Prevention of Obesity among Adults: Evidence- and Consensus-Based Guideline
sentinels.issuer: Evidence- and consensus-based guideline development group
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the adult obesity-prevention guideline as one principal normative document.
sentinels.relationship_notes: Incidental discovery in Drive is not itself a formal retrieval route; route provenance remains a separate GF-02/formal-search question.

sentinels.canonical_title: Management of dyslipidemia in adults. A consensus statement from the French Society of Endocrinology (SFE), the French-speaking Diabetes Society (SFD), the New French-speaking Atherosclerosis Society (NSFA) and the French Society of Cardiology (SFC).
sentinels.issuer: French Society of Endocrinology (SFE); French-speaking Diabetes Society (SFD); New French-speaking Atherosclerosis Society (NSFA); French Society of Cardiology (SFC)
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the joint French dyslipidemia consensus as one intellectual guideline/consensus unit anchored to NORM-035; linked journal co-publications are manifestations of the same intellectual document and do not create additional sentinel denominator units.
sentinels.relationship_notes: NORM-036 (DOI 10.1016/j.ando.2025.102471) and the Diabetes & Metabolism co-publication are linked manifestations. They may support retrieval/provenance but must be reconciled to the NORM-035 parent and never double-counted.

sentinels.canonical_title: Nutritional priorities to support GLP-1 therapy for obesity: a joint Advisory from ACLM, ASN, OMA, and The Obesity Society
sentinels.issuer: American College of Lifestyle Medicine; American Society for Nutrition; Obesity Medicine Association; The Obesity Society
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the four journal co-publications of the joint advisory as one intellectual document.
sentinels.relationship_notes: The AJCN manifestation is the canonical anchor. Parallel co-publications and corrigenda remain linked manifestations/materials, not additional sentinel units.

sentinels.canonical_title: 8. Obesity and Weight Management for the Prevention and Treatment of Diabetes: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the 2026 Standards of Care section as the current sentinel version; the 2025 section is historical and does not satisfy the current-version sentinel.
sentinels.relationship_notes: NORM-058 represents the superseded 2025 version and remains historical provenance only for this sentinel family.

sentinels.canonical_title: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics Diabetes Type 1 and 2 (2015) Evidence-Based Nutrition Practice Guideline
sentinels.issuer: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics Evidence Analysis Library
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the Academy EAL Diabetes Type 1 and 2 (2015) guideline as the institutional parent; linked JAND 2017 publications are manifestations/components and do not replace the parent silently.
sentinels.relationship_notes: The EAL institutional guideline is the canonical parent. The 2017 JAND articles, including DOI 10.1016/j.jand.2017.03.022 and its companion publication, are linked manifestations/components.

sentinels.canonical_title: Medical Nutrition Therapy Interventions Provided by Dietitians for Adult Overweight and Obesity Management: An Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics Evidence-Based Practice Guideline
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the Academy Adult Weight Management 2022 evidence-based guideline as the intellectual object; the JAND publication is its bibliographic manifestation.
sentinels.relationship_notes: The EAL identifies the guideline as version 2022; the JAND publication appears in 2023 and must remain reconciled to the same family.

sentinels.canonical_title: Evidence and consensus-based clinical practice guidelines for management of overweight and obesity in midlife women: An AIIMS-DST initiative
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the complete AIIMS-DST clinical practice guideline as the parent intellectual document. Executive summaries and parallel summary publications are linked manifestations/materials and do not increase the sentinel denominator.
sentinels.relationship_notes: NORM-037 (PMC9190956; DOI 10.4103/jmh.jmh_7_22) and NORM-038 (DOI 10.1016/j.dsx.2022.102426) are Executive Summary/parallel manifestations linked to the complete parent guideline and must not substitute for or duplicate it.

sentinels.canonical_title: Japanese Clinical Practice Guideline for Diabetes 2024 / 糖尿病診療ガイドライン2024
sentinels.issuer: Japan Diabetes Society; Minds Guideline Library
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the JDS 2024 guideline as the current parent document; the 2019 edition is historical and does not satisfy the current-version sentinel.
sentinels.relationship_notes: Minds identifier c00864 points to the current 2024 seventh edition. Prior JDS editions remain version history only for current-sentinel QA.

sentinels.canonical_title: Management of Hyperglycemia in Type 2 Diabetes, 2022. A Consensus Report by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) and the European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD)
sentinels.issuer: American Diabetes Association; European Association for the Study of Diabetes
sentinels.document_unit_rule: Count the ADA/EASD 2022 consensus as one intellectual document across Diabetes Care and Diabetologia co-publications.
sentinels.relationship_notes: Earlier consensus versions, including the 2015 family represented by NORM-008, are historical and do not satisfy the current 2022 sentinel.
